entries.title: DRAFT: Local spectral-measure Poisson pair calculus
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED DRAFT, not a solution of C0056. For any finite positive Borel measure nu on R and eta>0, ||P_eta*nu||_2^2 equals the nu-by-nu integral of P_(2eta)(s-t), and equals (2pi)^-1 integral exp(-2eta|u|)|nu_hat(u)|^2 du; finite atomic measures give the full nonnegative weighted eigenvalue-pair sum. The annealed uniform L2 criterion in L2 is stronger than mere absolute continuity.

entries.title: DRAFT: Conditional weighted-pair route to absolute continuity
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED DRAFT, not a solution of C0056. If finite-volume positive local measures of mass at most one obey E C_nuL(r)<=A r+B/N_L for every r>0 with volume-independent A,B, then E||P_eta*nu_L||_2^2 <= A/2+B/(2pi eta N_L). Here C_nu(r) is the same-measure pair mass at energy separation at most r. For bounded lattice Dirichlet approximations, take volume to infinity at each fixed eta before sending eta to zero; the result gives pure ac on covered cutoff windows if the displayed unproved bound holds.
assumptions: A,B finite and independent of volume,r
fixed site inside expanding Dirichlet cubes

entries.title: DRAFT: Missing conditional eigenvector mark estimate
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED DRAFT, not a solution of C0056. For finite-volume Anderson matrices with site-density bound R and cutoff support length W>0, if E sum_j a_j^2<=D/N and E[a_j a_k | all ordered eigenvalues]<=K/N^2 for j!=k uniformly in volume, then E C_nuL(r)<=max(18KR^2W,1/W)r+D/N for every r>0. The conditional mark hypothesis is explicitly UNPROVED for the target. Minami-type unweighted eigenvalue counts do not supply the mark assumption.
assumptions: independent bounded-density diagonal site laws; deterministic self-adjoint hopping
conditional mark hypothesis, not mere unconditional moments or IPR

entries.title: DRAFT: Flat eigenvectors with singular continuous spectral limit
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED DRAFT, not a solution of C0056. Real symmetric finite matrices with all eigenvector squared components and IPR equal to 1/N can have local measures converging to singular-continuous Cantor measure. With N=2^k and eta=N^-1/2, the diagonal smoothing contribution is 1/(2pi sqrt(N))->0, while the full second moment is at least N^((1-log(2)/log(3))/2)/(5pi)->infinity. The abstract counterexample refutes an IPR-only inference, not the Anderson conjecture.
assumptions: Walsh-basis matrix of multiplication by truncated fair ternary digit sum
abstract nonlocal matrices; not iid Anderson operators
countable infinite Walsh basis for the multiplication-operator limit

entries.title: DRAFT: Zero-disorder spectral-density calibration
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED DRAFT, not a solution of C0056. The free adjacency operator on Z3 has local density f1*f1*f1, f1(s)=1/[pi sqrt(4-s^2)] on(-2,2); its squared L2 norm is bounded by B(1/2,1/4)^2/(2pi^3). This calibrates the cutoff smoothing criterion at zero disorder only.
assumptions: normalized Haar Fourier measure on torus

entries.title: DRAFT: Separate C0056 spectral and GOE obligations
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED DRAFT, not a solution of C0056. The recovered Bourgade 2018 section 2.1 target combines weak-disorder ac spectrum on Z3 with a separate periodic-box GOE microscopic-statistics goal. The explicit uniform[-1,1] slice here has fixed-coupling quantifiers. A September 23, 2026 primary preprint claims the spectral part, but it is not independently certified in this packet. Current openness is UNKNOWN. This route proves neither parent goal; existence of an ac component, purity, nonzero spectral weight, and GOE statistics are distinct assertions.
assumptions: public preprint statement is a claim, not an accepted input

relations.rationale: The conditional concentration bound is integrated against the exact Poisson pair kernel before the fixed-eta volume limit.
The explicitly unproved conditional mark bounds plus the established count inequality would yield the weighted pair estimate.
The exact kernel sum has diverging cross terms despite a vanishing diagonal in the flat Walsh example.
An IPR bound alone cannot replace the required marked-pair control; the example makes no statement about iid lattice geometry.
At g=0 the free Z3 local density satisfies the smoothing criterion with an explicit finite constant.
The read-only source node and Bourgade p7 both retain AC and a separate GOE obligation.
Even proving this sufficient pure-ac criterion would leave GOE statistics and the independent review gates unresolved.
